entries.query: List every single wwe womans champion from the last 10 year
entries.answer:
Here is a comprehensive list of every WWE women's champion over the last 10 years (2016–2026), covering the two main championships: the **WWE Women's Championship** (formerly Raw Women's Championship) and the **Women's World Championship** (formerly SmackDown Women's Championship).

***

## WWE Women's Championship
*(formerly Raw Women's Championship, 2016–2023)*

This title was created at WrestleMania 32 in April 2016. Charlotte Flair was the inaugural champion, and she also holds the record for the most reigns with six.[1]

## Women's World Championship
*(formerly SmackDown Women's Championship, 2016–2023)*

The SmackDown Women's Championship was established in August 2016 when Raw and SmackDown split into separate brands, and it was rebranded as the Women's World Championship in June 2023. Becky Lynch was the inaugural champion of this title.[3]

Liv Morgan is the current Women's World Champion, having defeated Stephanie Vaquer at WrestleMania 42 Night 1 on April 18, 2026. As of that date, there have been 33 reigns between 15 champions in this title's history.[3]

***

## Notable Records & Highlights

**Charlotte Flair** stands out as the most decorated woman in WWE title history, holding the SmackDown/Women's World Championship a record seven times across both brands. **Becky Lynch** holds the record for the longest continuous reign on the Raw/WWE Women's Championship side, at 398 days, while **Bianca Belair** holds the record for the longest reign in the modern era of the Women's Championship at 419 days. Both Becky Lynch and Bianca Belair are the only two women in history to hold the championship for a continuous reign of one year or more.[4][1][3]
